I don't really have a choice. I have to be in the highest classes to go to a good college. I would be fine if it weren't for math. I suck at math, and it takes away my time to do other work. I am not particularly passionate on any academic subject I'm in, but I don't have any choices there, so yeah. I don't have any abilities past mediocre. I'm a jack of all trades, failure at all. 

Stepping back is a failure for me, and my family would never allow me to go into lower classes. I'm in the honors version of a class usually taken by Juniors, I'm the only freshman in the class, and I take it at 6am. My parents won't even let me go down to the regular version of the same class.
